regeln: Show authentic, source-supported tool interfaces or demos for every tool mentioned; never substitute with avatars, logos, symbolic icons, or unrelated stock footage.
Use 3-5 seconds of a genuinely distinct visual motif for each spoken segment in Shorts; long videos may have longer demonstrations but must still align tightly with narration.
A new motif must be a truly different visual element; zooms, crops, subtitle changes, decorative backgrounds, or minor label tweaks do not count as new motifs.
Introduce the correct channel presenter at the opening and reuse them for relevant actions throughout the video; do not replace them with unrelated characters.
Place all on-screen text, captions, and overlays within the inner title-safe zone with adequate padding to avoid clipping or overlap.
Maintain factual accuracy: avoid unsupported specifications, performance guarantees, invented details, or claims that a technique guarantees retention or views.
Include the mandatory spoken CTA (like, share, save) at the format-specific position; never replace it with a different call-to-action.
Follow the channel's original painted open-world aesthetic for backgrounds and branding; ensure each visual adds narrative value and avoids lifeless documentary photos.
Craft a clear narrative arc: hook, concise explanation, source-backed answer, then CTA, keeping the tone straightforward and informational.
When a script calls for a concrete example or demo, provide a brief, source-supported walkthrough that visually demonstrates the described benefit.
For Shorts, aim for 14-18 distinct relevant motifs (approx. 23 shots) as a planning target; for Business-Origin-Stories Shorts aim for about 18 distinct motifs (approx. 24 shots).
Front-load a direct factual or stakes-driven premise in hooks to eliminate cliché rhetorical questions and prevent narrative stalls or redundancies.

Der Kritiker schlug eine neue Null-Halluzinations-Garantie und andere Tools vor; diese Vorschlaege sind keine Quellen.
Kein Video erzeugt, keine Video-Note und keine Telegram-Videozustellung.
